fee_notes: Base fee of $30,000 for hotels with up to 100 guest rooms. Additional $300 per each additional guest room beyond 100. Maximum shown applies to 140-room hotels. Development Incentive Program available for Women-Owned and Veteran-Owned Businesses reduces fee by $10,000 with clawback if transferred within first year.
raw_excerpt: You must pay a lump sum initial franchise fee when you sign the Franchise Agreement in the amount of $30,000 for hotels with up to 100 guest rooms. You must pay an additional $300 for each additional guest room.
